settings.augmentation: deterministic image transform; first10blocks frozen/eval; last2 trainable without new image augmentation
settings.cache_precision: float16 prefix with prespecified mean absolute feature error<=0.001 and max<=0.02 checked on train-only rows
settings.class_order_semantics: partition class_order is rank-to-class, class_rank its inverse; headfirst66,midnext67,taillast67
settings.confirmation_scope: New holdout for this study; historical models may have seen these source rows; same-dataset followup, not external replication
settings.inference: raw and calibration-selected logit adjustment, tau0..2 by.05; uniform BalancedSoftmax prior => repeated tau0 view
settings.last_layer_computation: Original firsttrainable block evaluatesall197tokens; final block evaluatesCLSquery andCLSresidual/MLP only withallkeys/values, mathematically equivalent atzeroDeiTdropout; verified outputs/input/parameter gradients againstfullblock

preprocessing.augmentation: none; deterministic single view for all source images and both encoders
preprocessing.control_note: Shared bicubic transform matches DeiT evaluation interpolation; ResNet18 V1 normally uses bilinear. Tiny images are enlarged, not higher-resolution observations.
preprocessing.input: PIL RGB converted from original 64x64 image

settings.selection: best tuning-macroF1 epoch after calibration-selected logit adjustment; two LR candidates per arm; no confirmation or officialeval scoring until freeze
